title: DARPA smart dust field tests

tellings.quote: By 2001, DARPA was demonstrating smart dust in field tests.

plain: By 2001, DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, was showing off "smart dust" in field tests: swarms of tiny wireless sensors small enough to drift like dust. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a UFO book he says the Pentagon tried to censor, where it shows how far ahead secret military technology may have been.
